learning_outcomes.description: Frame business problems, distinguish Functional vs Non-Functional Requirements, and evaluate 4 product risks (Value, Usability, Feasibility, Viability).
Select optimal solution tiers on the Solution Ladder ranging from manual human processes to LLM/Agent tools.
Decompose tasks into Use Cases, model include vs extend relationships in UML diagrams, and draft rigorous specifications.
Architect end-to-end success pipelines with 5 key components: Trigger, Steps, Checkpoint, Result, and Saving metrics.

weeks.topic: Orientation, Problem Framing, Solution Ladder, Functional vs Non-Functional Requirements.
Task Decomposition, Anatomy of a Task, Use Case Diagram (include vs extend), MoSCoW Prioritisation.
Pitfalls & Success Pipelines, Human-in-the-loop, Checkpoints, 4 Pipeline Patterns.
System Architecture, API Design, Data Modeling, and Defensive Safeguards.
Engineering Quality, Red-teaming, Benchmark Dataset Construction, and AI Evaluation.
Midterm Milestone Report and Phase 1 Project Presentation.
Retrieval Integration, LLM Interface, and Cite-or-Refuse Citation Strategies.
Performance Optimization, Caching, Asynchronous Job Queues, and Background Workers.
Staging Deployment, CI/CD, Containerization with Docker Compose, and Runtime Monitoring.
Final Capstone Project Defense and Real-world Evaluation.
